name: Hook Regen

parameters.query:
=select p.id, p.name, p.tone, p.language, p.style, p.aspect, p.story_bible, p.editing_options,
  (select json_agg(json_build_object('id', c.id, 'ordinal', c.ordinal, 'title', c.title, 'script', c.chapter_script) order by c.ordinal) from hov.chapter c where c.project_id = p.id) as chapters,
  (select json_agg(s.id) from hov.scene s where s.project_id = p.id and s.scene_order < 100) as hook_scene_ids,
  (select json_agg(json_build_object('ref', e.ref, 'claim', e.claim, 'source', e.source_name, 'url', e.source_url, 'date', e.source_date) order by e.ref) from hov.evidence e where e.project_id = p.id) as evidence,
  (select row_to_json(g) from (select g.hook_rule, g.voice, g.format from hov.genre_profile g where g.active and lower(g.tone) = lower(coalesce(p.tone, '')) limit 1) g) as genre
from hov.project p
where p.id = $hov${{ $json.body.project_id }}$hov$

nodes.name: HR Release Flag

parameters.query:
=update hov.project
set editing_options = coalesce(editing_options, '{}'::jsonb) || '{"hookRegen": null}'::jsonb
where id = $hr${{ $('HR Prep').first().json.projectId }}$hr$

nodes.notes: A failed commit rolled the whole rewrite back, so the stored hook is untouched — but the site set editing_options.hookRegen before firing and only this run can clear it. Without this the producer is left watching a spinner with nothing alive behind it. Default batching on purpose: transaction batching is what made $N a hazard in the first place.

description: Webhook hook-regen {project_id, hook_style}: rewrites the teaser beats (same rules as Claude Scripting's Voice Mode + Hook Guard), writes one shot per beat, replaces the chapter-0 scenes, merges hookPlan and clears hookRegen.
